scope: Bundled native CHR recovery, registry contracts, project persistence, bitplane edit/export and real DOM event handlers in the VM harness; no browser rendering or universal semantic recovery claim.

results.name: Registry enforces unique versioned methods and physical source evidence
Any valid mapper and engine decode physical CHR with exact two-plane round-trip
Existing supplied Pepsi ROM is decoded by format without matching filename or hash
CHR RAM, raw/truncated layouts and invalid selections reject atomically
NES2 partial physical banks export only actual tiles and do not include padded editor tiles
Malformed and oversized persisted recovery metadata reject exports without changing tiles
Native import adds one editable stable-ID scene and preserves existing content
Import Undo and Redo restore project, stable source provenance and decoded pixels
Editing, saving, reopening and CHR export preserve changes and original byte identity
Stale and forged stages, duplicates and invalid pixels cannot mutate a project
UI mounts in the physical CHR viewer and explicit preview/import actions are reachable
UI refuses a stale ROM and exports edited CHR plus durable recovery evidence
